title: Hyper-CVAD Treatment of Adult T-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia in Sweden.
brief_summary: Hyper-CVAD (a chemotherapy regimen) has shown promising results in adult T-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (T-ALL). Patients with T-ALL diagnosis were reported to the Swedish Adult Acute Leukemia Registry between October 2002 and September 2006. Hyper-CVAD was recommended to all patients without severe comorbidity. Allogeneic stem cell transplantation was recommended for patients with high-risk disease. The aim of this population-based study was to assess the efficacy of Hyper-CVAD treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: all patients with T-ALL diagnosis

Exclusion Criteria: no
study_population: Patients with T-ALL diagnosis reported to the Swedish Adult Acute Leukemia Registry between October 2002 and September 2006
